# Central

> Central ("Central: chat e sicurezza") is a free mobile app for iPhone and Android, made in Italy, that combines end-to-end encrypted chat with personal and family safety tools: SOS, daily check-in, Safe Trip and safe zones. No ads. It is positioned as a private, European alternative to continuous location-tracking apps such as Life360: location is shared only during a trip, when leaving an agreed zone, or in an SOS.

Key facts (verified against the app, November 2026):

- Platforms: iOS (App Store, Italian and English) and Android (Google Play, Italian, English, Spanish, German, French, Albanian). Web dashboard for followers ("Guardian") in any browser.
- Messaging: one-to-one and group chats, photos, videos, voice notes, files, shared whiteboards and maps, end-to-end encrypted (X25519 + AES-256-GCM; group AES-256 keys; media AES-GCM). Crypto code is open source (Apache-2.0). No forward secrecy; the server sees metadata. Not anonymous.
- Calls: voice calls only (no video calls), encrypted with WebRTC DTLS-SRTP.
- SOS: sends location, battery level and, when started in the app, a 30-second front-camera video to emergency contacts. Triggers: in-app button; iPhone Siri ("Hey Siri, Central SOS") and Control Center; Android home-screen widget and Quick Settings tile. No volume-button trigger. It does not call emergency services (112).
- Emergency contacts: 2 free, 5 with Plus, unlimited with Premium.
- Hosting: server on Railway (EU region; Railway is a US company); encrypted files on Scaleway (France). Push, maps and email use US providers (Firebase/Apple, Mapbox, Resend).
- Pricing: core features free; Plus and Premium subscriptions via App Store / Google Play.
- Contact: info@getcentral.net
